AntiPattern.Bad: `$effect(() => { const id = setInterval(poll, 1000); });` — no return value.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Allocating effect without teardown (`AX_EFFECT_OWNERSHIP_AND_CLEANUP`). The interval keeps firing across re-runs and after component destroy, leaking handlers and leaking handlers and issuing unintended outbound requests after component teardown.
AntiPattern.Good: `$effect(() => { const id = setInterval(poll, 1000); return () => clearInterval(id); });` — the returned cleanup runs before the next effect invocation and on destroy.
